categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of orthopedic trauma medical devices, focusing on bone plates and screws designed for fracture fixation. It also offers customized surgical guide tools using medical imaging and 3D printing technologies, and acts as an agent for orthopedic filling materials and biological products such as artificial bone and platelet-rich plasma. The product portfolio includes trauma fixation implants, correction systems, spinal products, and代理 products like hemostatic agents and disposable surgical tools.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced design based on Asian skeletal curvature parameters, titanium alloy materials, and interlocking locking compression plate technology for enhanced fixation stability. It integrates medical imaging analysis, biomechanical engineering, digital modeling, and additive manufacturing (3D printing) to develop customized surgical guides and implants. Manufacturing involves CNC machining, surface treatment, cleaning, assembly, sterilization, and strict quality control compliant with ISO13485 standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international distributors and hospitals, with end users being orthopedic surgeons and medical institutions. The company serves the orthopedic trauma and correction market, targeting patients with fractures, degenerative joint diseases, and spinal conditions. Major markets are Taiwan (over 75% revenue share), China, and Southeast Asia, with growing penetration in other Asian countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are concentrated in Taiwan, China, and Southeast Asia, with export markets including Japan, Vietnam, Singapore, and Malaysia. The company has offices and factories in New Taipei City, Taiwan, and a subsidiary in Shanghai, China. It aims to expand its international presence and increase global market share, especially in Asian countries with similar skeletal characteristics.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the orthopedic medical device supply chain. It designs, develops, and assembles finished implants and surgical tools, sourcing raw materials like titanium alloys and polymers from qualified upstream suppliers. It sells products through distributors and directly to hospitals, providing clinical support and customized solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in trauma fixation products tailored to Asian anatomy, development of new materials such as polymer composites, and expansion of customized surgical guide tools using 3D printing and AI-assisted preoperative planning. The company emphasizes collaboration with medical centers and academic institutions to incorporate clinical feedback and accelerate product development. It also focuses on expanding sales channels domestically and internationally while enhancing product quality and cost competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of self-developed orthopedic implants and代理 products. The company also earns income from distribution agreements for imported orthopedic materials. It does not disclose subscription or licensing models; revenue growth is driven by increased sales volume, new product introductions, and geographic market expansion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in Taiwan's orthopedic trauma implant market with over 30% market share, slightly behind the global leader Synthes (DePuy). Internationally, it competes against large multinational orthopedic device manufacturers with standardized products designed for Western populations. Its competitive advantage lies in specialized products designed for Asian skeletal anatomy, integrated surgical planning services, and rapid response to clinical needs, differentiating it from both imported brands and low-cost domestic imitators.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$770 million, a 14% increase year-over-year, and a net profit of NT$151 million compared to a prior net loss. Gross margin improved to 70%, and earnings per share reached NT$4.99. The company maintains a stable financial position with total assets around NT$1.18 billion and equity of NT$919 million, showing solid growth and profitability recovery.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers orthopedic trauma implants uniquely designed based on Asian skeletal curvature, providing better anatomical fit and clinical outcomes compared to Western-designed products. Its integrated approach combining advanced materials, locking plate technology, and customized 3D-printed surgical guides enhances surgical precision, reduces operation time, and improves patient recovery. The company emphasizes high product quality, regulatory compliance, and strong clinical support, creating a differentiated value proposition in both domestic and international markets.
